title: Proper base change with $\kunZn$-coefficients
statement: Let $n\geq1$ be an integer and put $\Lambda=\mathbf Z/n\mathbf Z$. Let $f:X\to Y$ be a proper morphism of schemes [def-weil-proper-morphism], let $g:Y^{\prime}\to Y$ be any morphism, and form the cartesian square [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square] with $X^{\prime}=Y^{\prime}\times_YX$ and projections $f^{\prime}:X^{\prime}\to Y^{\prime}$ and $g^{\prime}:X^{\prime}\to X$. For every $K\in D(X_{\Et},\Lambda)$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], the canonical unbounded exchange morphism [def-kun-unbounded-exchange] $$\Ex_{\square,K}:g^{-1}Rf_*K\longrightarrow Rf^{\prime}_*(g^{\prime})^{-1}K$$ is an isomorphism in $D(Y^{\prime}_{\Et},\Lambda)$. No invertibility assumption on $n$ is imposed.

proof.text:
Put Λ=ULift(ZMod n). Positivity of n supplies NeZero n, so Λ is finite and
isAddTorsion_of_finite shows that Λ is additively torsion. Every Λ-module sheaf is
therefore a torsion module sheaf. For the fibre base-change input, apply the full
abelian torsion-assembly theorem to the underlying abelian sheaf, then transport its
single-object derived exchange through the forgetful and restriction-of-scalars
coefficient comparisons to Λ. This is the finite cyclic coefficient comparison;
no prime-field statement is used.

Geometric-point inverse images jointly detect zero sheaves. Indeed apply isIso_of_isIso_upperStar_map_of_jointlySurjective to 0→M and the geometric points associated to all scheme points. Each point has a lift of its underlying scheme point. The target and source of every pulled-back map are zero, so it is invertible. Conservativity makes 0→M invertible. The proof is also valid for the empty scheme.

For a proper map p:S→T and a point t of T, base change to x:Spec(algClosure κ(t))→T. Its fibre projection is proper, hence finite type over this algebraically closed field. exists_topologicalKrullDim_le supplies d bounding the fibre dimension. Apply the relative torsion-module direct-image dimension bound to the fibre projection and the identity of Spec(algClosure κ(t)), giving vanishing for q>2d.

Apply the full torsion-assembly theorem to the underlying abelian sheaf G[0] in the
fibre square. Its derived exchange is an isomorphism. The explicit coefficient
comparison through restriction of scalars from ULift ℤ to Λ, together with the
module/abelian derived exchange compatibility, transports this conclusion to the
Λ-coefficient map used below. The composite of homologyRightDerivedFunctorPlusObjSingleFunctorIso,
mapDerivedCategoryPlusHomologyFunctorIso, homology of this exchange isomorphism, and
mapDerivedCategoryPlusSingleFunctor identifies the resulting geometric-point pullback
with the fibre higher direct image.

The map f′ is proper by base-change stability. For each point of Y′ choose its bound from the preceding step. Exact geometric-point inverse images preserve monomorphisms, and step 2 says they jointly detect zero. Apply the pointwise finite-cohomological-dimension exact-complex theorem to f′_*. It shows that f′_* sends exact unbounded complexes of f′_*-acyclic sheaves to exact complexes, with no uniform global bound or quasi-compactness assumption on Y′.

The source HasTorsionBaseChange.hasInjectiveAcyclicity applied to the bounded torsion
base-change property of f gives that every pulled-back injective torsion module sheaf
is f′_*-acyclic. The torsion input is the full torsion-assembly theorem, transported
through the same module/abelian and restriction-of-scalars coefficient comparisons;
underived proper exchange is supplied separately. Since Λ is torsion, this applies to
every injective Λ-module sheaf.

Apply isIso_derivedBaseChangeMap_of_isIso_baseChangeMap to the underived exchange isomorphism, exact-complex preservation from step 5 and pulled-injective acyclicity from step 6. This criterion computes the specified unbounded adjunction mate, so it proves invertibility of the original canonical derivedBaseChangeMap as a natural transformation, with exactly the original hypotheses.

split_report.summary: Made the implicit coefficient integer explicit; replaced the invalid field-dependent telescope proof by the actual proof of Stacks 0F0C. One new statement-only node is the arbitrary-torsion proper cohomological bound 095U. Existing 0A3V, 07K7, 079P, 0EZR and coefficient-comparison nodes handle all remaining non-elementary facts. Canonical exchange and locality are checked without confusing unbounded module and abelian derived categories.
split_report.blueprint: Replaces the sole blueprint proof paragraph: proper base change is retained, but its unsupported field hypothesis is removed by 0F0C first sentence (locality), 0A3V/095U (finite dimension), 079P (resolution), and 07K7 (unbounded computation). No unit-level route or statement is changed.

tool_uses.why: Uniform ordinary-fibre bound for a finite-type map over a quasi-compact base, the 0A3V input to 0F0C; the unit provides no such bound.
Grothendieck-category resolutions with both K-injectivity and injective terms, the 079P input to 0F0C; used as a homological tool.
Acyclicity after coefficient restriction, used for Z to Lambda and the identity; no smooth-base-change conclusion or route is imported.
Generic additive left-exact constant-coefficient direct image, needed to apply 07K7.
The sheaf-level canonical proper base-change theorem 095T on each injective term, explicitly required by 0F0C; not a replacement for the unit theorem.
Generic exact module inverse image and its adjunction with underlying abelian unit and counit, needed for representatives and the mate calculation.
Generic unbounded canonical-exchange locality 0EZR(2), used to remove quasi-compactness, without invoking smooth base change.
Generic Grothendieckness of module sheaves on a small ringed site, needed for 079P and 07K7.
Generic exact-left-adjoint criterion 08BJ, used to compute the derived adjunction on the chosen representatives.
